Formula: distance NM / vessel speed knots / 24. Real voyage duration additionally depends on routing, weather, speed variation, traffic and operational conditions.
Formula adds sea, ballast, waiting and port days. Accuracy depends on the supplied day assumptions.

Reconciles fuel + port + transit + adjusted route cost under the current engine definition.
Revenue minus voyage cost under the current engine. Additional dashboard costs such as hire/OPEX/demurrage may be applied separately.
Voyage profit divided by total voyage days under the engine definition. Commercial interpretation depends on which costs have been included.
